source_title: Market Share Alert: Preliminary, Mobile Phones, Worldwide, 4Q24

claim_relevant_segments.mobile_phone_q4_growth: Preliminary estimates indicate a 2.1% YoY increase in mobile phone unit sales to end users in 4Q24.

researcher_paraphrase: Gartner's preliminary 4Q24 mobile-phone alert measured quarterly end-user unit sales growth of 2.1% and smartphone sales growth of 2.7%.
precision_guard: This is a preliminary fourth-quarter sales-to-end-users observation, not a full-year shipment outcome. It is not directly comparable to Gartner's calendar-2024 shipment forecasts.
authority_boundary: Gartner is authoritative for this preliminary quarterly measurement; scope/period/measurement terminology must be preserved.
